title: Cohomology factorization of the affine algebra derived unit
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an affine morphism [def-pc-scheme], and $g:(X,\mathcal O_X)\to(Y,f_*\mathcal O_X)$ its canonical ringed-space morphism [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Let $P:\operatorname{Mod}(f_*\mathcal O_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] preserve finite limits, with an adjunction $a:P\dashv g_*$. Let $L:D(f_*\mathcal O_X)\to D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] have an adjunction $b:L\dashv Rg_*$ to [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. For any $M$ with quasi-coherent cohomology [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category] and integer $n$, there is an isomorphism $e:H^n(Rg_*L M)\cong g_*P H^n(M)$ such that $H^n(b_M)\,;\,e=a_{H^n(M)}$.

proof.text: The given P is additive because its right adjoint g_* is additive, and preserves finite colimits because it is a left adjoint. Together with the finite-limit hypothesis, P is exact. Use a.mapDerivedCategoryRightDerivedAdjunction to obtain the canonical adjunction D(P) ⊣ Rg_*. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies L with D(P). The natural exact-functor homology isomorphism then gives H^n(-) followed by P naturally isomorphic to L followed by H^n(-).

Derived pullback L sends M to an object with quasi-coherent cohomology. Show that Rg_* also preserves quasi-coherent cohomology: restriction T from f_*O_X to O_Y has unchanged underlying abelian sheaves, so preserves finite limits and colimits (the private proved helper restriction_exact). Its exact-derived comparison and the composition comparison identify Rg_* followed by RT with Rf_*. Choose the standard derived category on O_Y-modules as an auxiliary category. The affine cohomology formula and the ordinary correspondence imply quasi-coherence of each H^i(Rg_*K), after restriction and hence before restriction.

Apply the canonical exact-derived counit isomorphism to K=L(M). The adjunction-compatible uniqueness isomorphism carries that counit to the counit of adj, so the latter is invertible at L(M). The left triangle identity now makes L applied to the derived unit at M invertible.

Naturality of the exact homology isomorphism from Step 1 shows that P applied to H^n of the derived unit is invertible. Both H^n(M) and H^n(Rg_*L(M)) are quasi-coherent, by the hypothesis and Step 2. The ordinary unit components at these two modules are invertible by the affine algebra module adjunction isomorphisms. Their naturality equation shows that H^n of the derived unit, followed by the target ordinary unit, is invertible; cancel that ordinary unit to deduce invertibility of H^n of the derived unit.

Define e to be the inverse of the isomorphism H^n(adj.unit.app M), followed by the ordinary unit isomorphism at H^n(M). Associativity and inverse cancellation give the required equality. The statement asks for an existential isomorphism, not a specified canonical cohomology comparison, so this witness suffices. No use of the existing derived counit factorization, whose current proof plan depends on this item, occurs.

theorem affine_algebra_derived_unit_homology_factorization
    {X Y : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [IsAffineHom f]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wX} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)))]
    (P : SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f)) ⥤
      SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    (a : P ⊣ RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f))
    [Limits.PreservesFiniteLimits P]
    (L : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))) ⥤
      schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (adj : L ⊣ RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f))
    (M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))))
    (hM : directImageAlgebraDerivedQCohProperty f M) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃ e : (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))) n).obj
          ((RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).obj
            (L.obj M)) ≅
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace f)).obj
          (P.obj ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))) n).obj M)),
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))) n).map
          (adj.unit.app M) ≫ e.hom =
        a.unit.app ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace f))) n).obj M)
